## What we adopt
Centered single card, logo above, email/password, remember-me, primary full-width button.

## What Ad Astra changes
Ad Astra icon and navy/cyan tokens; username instead of email; no social sign-in; no sign-up link (accounts are created by a teacher).

Ad Astra branding (plan §1.1) always overrides template colours and logos.
